visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a traditional white menu board featuring red and blue Chinese characters, showcasing incredibly low prices for breakfast items like soy milk and rice milk. A man with black hair and a sleeveless black shirt is seen observing the board with a look of surprise. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit food display case inside a local restaurant. Various pre-packaged sandwiches and yellow egg pancakes are visible on silver trays. A hand enters the frame and picks up a bag containing an egg pancake, showing the tactile texture of the plastic packaging. (3) Three people, one male and two females, are seated at a stainless steel table in a casual indoor dining environment. The male character holds a plastic cup of soy milk and a packaged sandwich while gesturing enthusiastically. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a local eatery. (4) A series of extreme close-ups feature different dishes: a plate of stir-fried noodles topped with savory minced meat and a side of broccoli, followed by several small bowls of soup including pig blood soup and egg flower soup. The food is steam-hot and presented simply on plastic-covered plates. (5) The shot changes to show a full bento meal consisting of a large fried pork chop, a scoop of white rice, green leafy vegetables, a slice of braised tofu, and pieces of Chinese sausage. The camera pans slightly to emphasize the variety of ingredients. (6) In the final phase, the three characters are back at the table, summarizing their meal costs. Digital graphic overlays with numerical values (15, 30, 50, 95) appear over the frame as they react with cheerful expressions and hand gestures, celebrating the low total cost.
